blocks.title: Set up and run untrusted checks locally
blocks.code:
zig build unit && zig build test-trace && zig build test-evmc
bun test ./ts/
bun .smithers/scripts/run-trusted-ci.ts --untrusted ci '//...'
uphill --compact

blocks.title: Connect your agent via Smithers Cloud MCP
blocks.code:
claude mcp add guillotine-mini --transport http https://smithers.sh/evmts/guillotine-mini/mcp
codex mcp add guillotine-mini --url https://smithers.sh/evmts/guillotine-mini/mcp
agy mcp add guillotine-mini --transport http https://smithers.sh/evmts/guillotine-mini/mcp

cards.title: Run untrusted locally
cards.text: Contributors are encouraged to run tests, EEST conformance, flows, and Lighthouse audits locally with read-only cache access.

cards.title: Trusted merge gates
cards.text: Only Smithers-controlled sandboxes and maintainers write the shared cache or satisfy merge gates.

cards.title: Spec-first evidence
cards.text: Cite the Python execution-specs line and include a minimal failing regression before writing a fix.

cards.title: Person-only merge
cards.text: Agents reproduce, review, and report backpressure. Only a human maintainer approves and lands to main.

blocks.title: Guillotine Mini
blocks.tagline: Minimal, formally verified, universal EVM in Zig, C, EVMC, and WebAssembly.
blocks.text: 100% Frontier through Osaka EEST conformance (66,652 tests), Glamsterdam EIPs, 210 Lean 4 theorems with zero sorrys, 51 C and WASM exports, EVMC ABI 12 shared library, and a 92.8 KiB gzipped modular WASM core.

announcement.label: v0.2.0 live with 66,652 EEST pass, 210 Lean 4 proofs, Glamsterdam EIPs, and browser debugger

stats.label: Official Frontier to Osaka EEST pass
Lean 4 formal proofs with zero sorrys
Modular WASM core with 51 C exports

cards.title: 100% EEST conformance
cards.text: Every single Frontier through Osaka state test in official execution-spec-tests v21.0.3 passes in 18.5 seconds in CI.

cards.title: 210 Lean 4 theorems
cards.text: Executable Lean 4 EVM specification with multi-frame rollback and Glamsterdam EIP-8037 proofs, zero sorrys, and 14,784 diff vectors.

cards.title: Run anywhere in 92.8 KiB
cards.text: Zero-dependency TypeScript SDK with a 1 KB WASI shim runs identically in browsers, Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, and Node.

cards.title: 51 C ABI and EVMC 12 exports
cards.text: Single-header C99 API, EVMC ABI 12 shared library, async state injection, SVG gas flamegraphs, and ABI revert decoding.

cards.title: Glamsterdam ready
cards.text: Implements SLOTNUM, DUPN/SWAPN/EXCHANGE, 64 KiB code limits, 2D state gas reservoirs, ETH transfer logs, and BAL recording.

cards.title: Public coding factory
cards.text: Incremental Smithers CI over a shared object store, public MCP server, live browser playground, and Lighthouse audit reports.
